Then 96f.1 (sanitizer mode) and 96f.3 (Valgrind container) in parallel. Then 96f.4/.5/.6 (at most 3 agents), then 96f.2 (mix defk.verify + release alias).

Deferred 2026-10-13 (focus review): expansion work waits until the verdict closes (defk-sgw.6). The date is a placeholder; the trigger is defk-sgw.6 closing. Nothing is dropped: bw ready hides deferred issues, bw list --all shows them.
